name: dioptra-sandbox-runners
description: The JS/TS runners the E7 sandbox executes the developer's tests with. Installed at BUILD time into /opt/dioptra-js so the audited tree cannot shadow them with its own node_modules, and so the image ships to an air-gapped factory as one artefact. Licences: vitest MIT, @vitest/coverage-v8 MIT, Stryker Apache-2.0 (Stryker is the plan's mutation tool for JS/TS, CLAUDE.md -> Analysis Tool Source Authority; the test runner and its coverage provider are not in that table, which names the analysis pipeline's capabilities). Verified by scripts/ci.sh, which runs the licence gate inside the built image.
